test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error. 

Her friends house is close to the high school where Sarathi teaches.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Her friends'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct word to be used in this sentence is '**Her friend's**.
 
• We use '**apostrophe**' **s** to show **possession** or **ownership**.
 
• Here in the sentence '**Friend's**' is to be used as it is talking about the house which belongs to her friend

Hence the correct sentence would be '**Her friend's house is close to the high school where Sarathi teaches'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• If the sentence had started with '**one of my friends'.** 
 
• the sentence would be correct as '**one of'** indicates a **particular person or thing**.
 
 
• For eg:- One of the bananas is rotten.
